parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Egwi, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Egwi, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station Egwi, Etche LGA**

The VES interpretation at Station Egwi reveals a five-layer subsurface sequence with resistivity increasing progressively with depth:

- Layer 1: 295.88 Ω·m (0–0.545 m) – likely topsoil/weathered layer
- Layer 2: 798.6 Ω·m (0.545–4.138 m)
- Layer 3: 864.62 Ω·m (4.138–6.294 m)
- Layer 4: 1810.2 Ω·m (6.294–37.25 m)
- Layer 5: 5634.2 Ω·m (basement, depth not fully resolved)

Applying the curve-type convention to successive triplets: layers 1-2-3 give r1<r2<r3 (A), layers 2-3-4 give r1<r2<r3 (A), and layers 3-4-5 give r1<r2<r3 (A). All three triplets yield the same letter, confirming a consistent ascending resistivity trend typical of a basement complex terrain with increasing competency at depth. This matches the on-file classification of the curve as A-type, with no inconsistency noted between the computed letter sequence and the stated label.

Recommend proceeding with drilling plan as per standard A-type curve guidelines, anticipating competent basement layer at depth.

{"curve_type_stated": "A", "label_issue_flagged": false}
